en.headline: Tai Po fire reform steering committee holds first meeting
en.dek: Chief Secretary Eric Chan urged departments to roll out ready measures immediately and complete legislative amendments at full speed.
body: A government steering committee tasked with implementing reforms after the deadly Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po held its first meeting on Monday.

Chief Secretary Eric Chan Kwok-ki, who chairs the committee, directed bureaux and departments to roll out measures that are ready for implementation as soon as possible. He said preparatory work for items involving legislative amendments must be completed at full speed so that proposals can be submitted to the Legislative Council as soon as practicable.

The government said relevant departments reviewed work plans, division of duties, implementation proposals and timetables during the meeting. The committee will hold regular meetings to oversee the reforms and legislative work.

The independent committee that investigated the fire, which killed 168 people including a firefighter, put forward 120 recommendations covering building maintenance, bid-rigging, fire safety regulations and government oversight. The steering committee was established to drive implementation of those recommendations.

zh.headline: 大埔火災改革督導委員會首次會議召開
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基要求部門盡快推行已準備就緒的措施，並全速完成立法修訂準備工作。
body: 負責推展大埔宏福苑致命火災後改革的政府督導委員會周一召開首次會議。
擔任主席的政務司司長陳國基指示各政策局及部門，已準備就緒的措施必須盡快推行。他表示，涉及立法修訂的項目須全速完成準備工作，以便盡早提交立法會審議。
政府表示，相關部門在會議上檢視工作計劃、職責分工、推行建議及時間表。委員會將定期召開會議，監督改革及立法工作的進展。
獨立委員會調查造成168人死亡（包括一名消防員）的火災後提出120項建議，涵蓋樓宇維修、圍標、消防安全規例及政府監管等方面。督導委員會的設立旨在推動落實這些建議。
